sloka: सो ऽभिगम्य रघुश्रेष्ठं दीप्यपानं स्वतेजसा ।ऋषिर्मधुरया वाचा वर्धस्वेत्याह राघवम् ।। ७.१०३.८ ॥
transliteration: so 'bhigamya raghuśreṣṭhaṁ dīpyapānaṁ svatejasā ।ṛṣirmadhurayā vācā vardhasvetyāha rāghavam ।। 7.103.8 ॥

translations.english: Having approached Rama, the best of the Raghus, who was shining with his own splendor, the sage said to him with a sweet voice, "May you prosper."
